control_failures.control_label: integrity of explosion-protected equipment in zoned areas
proving zero energy before intrusive work

facts.site: Marrindal Concentrator and Hydrocarbon Transfer Facility
facts.title: unplanned release of electrical energy at SG-4100

response.consequence: The recorded outcome was no injury or loss. The potential outcome was rated 1 against the site's consequence scale, above the 0 actually realised.

defences.finding: Control HAZARDOUS_AREA_EQUIPMENT_INTEGRITY: the integrity of explosion-protected equipment in zoned areas had degraded below its design intent, and the learning team review classified this as an individual or team action.
Control ZERO_ENERGY_VERIFICATION: the proving zero energy before intrusive work had been bypassed, and the learning team review classified this as a task or environmental condition.

recommendations: Confirm at the next assurance activity that the integrity of explosion-protected equipment in zoned areas on SG-4100 and TX-3002 performs as designed.
response.sequence: Work was under way in maintaining protective systems, specifically inspecting and maintaining portable equipment. SG-4100 (switchgear and transformers) is in service for plant HV/LV distribution. The task proceeded during cleaning and preparation while the integrity of explosion-protected equipment in zoned areas had degraded below its design intent. The electrical energy involved is held as HV switchgear, and the recorded presentation was shock, arc flash, unplanned energisation.
response.summary: On 29 March 2024 a high potential incident was recorded on SG-4100 and TX-3002 at Marrindal Concentrator and Hydrocarbon Transfer Facility during cleaning and preparation; electrical energy held as HV switchgear was not released.
